lines: There you are. I've had the timber stacked since Tuesday.
Magistrate said you'd be along. Didn't say when.
Your house. That one, with the roof off it.
Deed's in your name. Has been a while now.
He never told you, did he.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

lines: That's him. Does a thing for you and lets you find out on your own.
Reckons saying it out loud would make it a favour you owed.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

lines: Nobody. I put things back up.
Timber and stone. Valley's full of both if you don't mind the walk.
Gate's south. Come back with a satchel and we'll start.
